New Unity products and prices launching in June

I left the title alone, but I wanted to add how much this angers me.

My anger is a bit irrational. I'm a hobbyist (who has occasionally tried to sell games).

I didn't really need to pay for Unity. The splash screen was really bothering me and Unity 5 was coming out soon. I shelled out $1500 knowing that once I got the $750 upgrade price with Unity 6 that I'd have a great hobby for a cheap price. And then Level 11 turned out to be pretty awesome and I got a ton of resources that will last me years. Bonus!

Now my "upgrade" price is $1500 per year. Will I get the same amount of features found in "Unity 1 - Unity 5" every single year? I doubt it.

If I was getting a bug-free, feature-complete version of Unity 5 in June, I wouldn't complain at all. But I'm not getting a bug-free Unity 5, and it will very likely start to fail after a few years.
